name: remind
description: Reminders inside Claude Code: say "remind me to…" and a band above the prompt shows what's due. Kept in a local list or your Apple Reminders, with git and deploy status in a pane.

source.title: Where reminders live
source.description: local: a list Claude keeps in ~/.claude/remind/reminders.json, on any computer. apple: a list in the Reminders app (macOS).

appleList.title: Reminders list
appleList.description: The Reminders app list to read and add to, when the source is apple. Made for you on the first reminder if it doesn't exist.

repos.title: Repos to watch deploys for
repos.description: GitHub repos whose latest production deploy shows in the pane, comma-separated (owner/repo, owner/other). Needs the gh CLI, signed in. Leave empty to hide deploys.
